profile.summary: OK Program of Oakland is a nonprofit mentoring and leadership organization for Black boys and young men ages 12 to 18. It works with police officers, school districts and faith communities to build leadership and critical thinking skills, support school success and reduce incarceration and homicide among young Black males.
